decision.reason: evidence sufficient (proxy gate verdict; the open aspects need proposals): [ev-f3322dd7e7b5] says what changed: the project's own E2E test steps are now re-run automatically when they fail. That covers the subject (the E2E test setup), the change (retry on failure) and, by reading, the applicability: no customer environment is exposed, because this is internal to testing. It names no API, flag, default or runtime behaviour. The open aspects can therefore be written as "no product subject, informational", and more detail from the PR would not change that. Confidence is low because the release note never says outright that operators are unaffected; that comes from reading "E2E step" as internal testing.
